Riley (prod): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands sec segment. Customers asked three things: how to prove log integrity to auditors, short BYOQ vs BYOK phrasing, and what to expect for Private control-plane observability. Can security/compliance answer here?

Jordan (security): Short answers: 1) Integrity: we provide daily signed bundles (manifest + events.ndjson.gz + detached signature) and a signed export receipt with timestamp. 2) BYOK vs BYOQ: BYOK = customer-managed keys in cloud KMS; BYOQ = key material stays in a customer HSM (we record attestation). 3) Private: control-plane calls are still logged at the edge and included in bundles; data-plane logs are opt-in.

Tara (compliance): For auditors: suggested language for reports: "Redwood delivers daily signed audit bundles containing event records, a manifest with SHA256 checksums, and a digital signature. Customers may archive bundles in their own storage for audit retention requirements."

Maya (support): Example verification steps customers can show auditors?

Jordan (security): Provide these steps: 1) download bundle, 2) compute SHA256 of events file, 3) compare against manifest, 4) verify signature with our public key: `gpg --verify signatures.asc manifest`. We'll add a one-page walkthrough.

Vikram (infra): Tech notes: default hosted retention = 90d. Daily export to customer S3 is supported unlimited. Full payload capture is disabled by default; opt-in truncates at 8KB unless configured otherwise. Exports are gzipped and named like: `exports/2026-11-01/<tenant>/audit-bundle-20261101.tar.gz`.

Riley (prod): Great. Can we get a small FAQ and a single-sentence line for sales?

Tara (compliance): Sales one-liner: "Default audit log retention is 90 days; customers can configure daily signed exports to their storage for long-term retention and auditor evidence. BYOK and BYOQ supported; BYOQ includes HSM attestation."

Calendar Bot: Reminder: Security office hours "Audit exports & BYOQ deep dive" scheduled at 1992253600. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.company/officehours-security

Jordan (security): Actions: I'll post the verification commands and public key, Tara will draft the auditor checklist by EOW, Vikram will add export filename examples to docs. Riley will add the one-liner to sales enablement.

Riley (prod): Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
